author: reek
body: Custom field system for flexible product metadata. A store defines field templates (wine: vintage, region, grape; electronics: wattage, connector; art: medium, dimensions, framing). Products reference templates and store values. Fields render in listings, detail pages, and filter panels automatically.

author: reek
body: Fields are organized into groups for rendering. A "Wine" template might have groups "Details" (vintage, region, grape, ABV) and "Tasting Notes" (aroma, palate, finish).

author: reek
body: A template is a named collection of field groups that applies to a product category. When you add a product to "Wine", it gets all the wine fields. Templates are additive: a product can have multiple.
